raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Since 2026-01-15 the v2 collector emits txn_ts in UTC, while legacy emits America/Chicago local time, and silver mixes the two. v2 rows from the Chicago evening therefore land in the 00:00-06:00 UTC window and on the next date, which explains the 2026-01-19 volume drop and the off-hours alerts. Converting v2 timestamps to Chicago local time matches the historical legacy convention (the day starts at 06:00 local, which is 12:00 UTC for v2) and fixes txn_ts and txn_date.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.85,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP))) AS TIMESTAMP) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') s;"}}
